facts.text: Portrait-format character reference sheet arranged in three rows: a large cinematic full-body hero panel at top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and four close-up detail panels across the bottom.
The reference subject is a person with short dark hair, shaved sides, and a small tied knot at the back, wearing a black high-collared tactical jacket, black trousers, and black combat boots.

The top panel shows the figure standing on a rain-slicked nighttime walkway with metal railings on both sides, rain streaks visible, reflective wet ground, a building facade behind, and warm amber lights in the distance.
The middle row contains three studio views of the same figure against a plain dark background: a frontal full-body view, a side-profile full-body view, and a rear full-body view.
The bottom row consists of close-up panels showing the face, jacket collar with strap and buckle details, two hands with visible veins, and black lace-up boots.
The face close-up shows a neutral expression and a visible scar through one eyebrow.
On-screen labels read: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

The lighting is low-key and high-contrast, with cool blue-gray night tones and warm amber practical lights in the hero panel, while the studio panels use soft directional lighting against a near-black background.

limitations: Static image only; no motion, camera movement, audio, music, voice, or transcript can be observed.
Some fine details in the darkest areas of the studio panels are difficult to distinguish.

card.summary: A portrait-format character reference sheet for a black-clad tactical figure labeled HERO, combining a rainy nighttime full-body shot, front/side/back turnaround views, and close-up details of the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots.
